text: ポケモンが　とても　きもち　よさそうに　ねてます

structure.jp: とても　きもち　よさそうに

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks like)
patterns.explanation: そう added to a describing word means 'looks like it is'. いい becomes よさそう in a special way, and に turns it into how the sleeping is done. きもち よさそうに = 'looking like it feels good'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on right now. ねてます is the short spoken form of ねています, with the い dropped. ねてます = 'is sleeping'.
